card.fires_on: Punctuation and small words inside World of Warcraft style wiki text, especially the dots and colon in patch version numbers like 'Patch 4.0.3 (15-Nov-2010):'. It also fires weakly on words in item or spell descriptions such as 'Summons an object'.

modes.label: Patch version numbers
